title: Your student bank account is “under review”
scenario: A caller ID shows your bank name. The caller says unusual transfers triggered a review and asks you to approve a login notification so they can inspect the account.

answers.A: Deny the prompt, hang up, and contact the bank through its app or the number on your card.
answers.B: Freeze transfers/cards in the bank app first, then call the bank yourself.
answers.C: Approve once because the caller ID matches and the approval is only for inspection.

explanation: MFA approval authorizes account access; it is not a view-only inspection tool.
proTip: A security prompt is a door, not a support ticket.
